title: Website & Brand Identity Analysis
desc: Analyzed existing jzarrtech.com website to extract core company information, services, visual identity, tech stack, and corporate positioning before commencing frontend redesign.

title: Core PHP Architecture & Modular Setup
desc: Built a modular PHP codebase featuring reusable navbar and footer components across 7 main pages: index, about, services, portfolio, technology, process, and contact.

title: Light Theme & Visual Tokens Setup
desc: Implemented a clean light theme design system with custom CSS variables for typography (Outfit, JetBrains Mono), neon purple/cyan gradients, and soft shadow elevations.

title: Figma & Reference Design Alignment
desc: Analyzed uploaded design reference images and Figma project files to recreate section order, layout spacing, visual rhythm, and card structures.

title: Three.js 3D Gyroscopic Orbit Engine
desc: Engineered a WebGL 3D gyroscopic stage in the hero section using Three.js with multi-axis rotating Torus rings, ambient lighting, and orbiting satellite spheres.

title: Hero 3D Orbit Side-Clipping Fix
desc: Expanded hero 3D orbit viewport height to 560px and adjusted camera distance to z=420 to prevent multi-axis gyroscopic rings from clipping on screen edges.

title: Full-Hero Ambient Background Canvas
desc: Extended floating particle dots canvas across the entire hero section background featuring 75 drifting navy, purple, and cyan dots with subtle constellation lines.

title: Official 3D JT TECH Logo Integration
desc: Integrated user-uploaded 3D JT TECH brand mark into the navbar, footer, center of hero 3D orbit, and Section 02 orbit using crisp guaranteed HTML overlays.

title: Section 02 Interactive Vector Network Orbit
desc: Built a live 2D/3D system orbit in Section 02 featuring 7 revolving technology nodes (Cloud, Web, Mobile, Data, AI, Platforms, Products) with vector icons.

title: Section 03 Architectural Redesign
desc: Removed the 'Watch Our Story' image frame and transformed Section 03 into a balanced 2-column layout with corporate hierarchy tree panel and metrics pills.

title: Capabilities Bento Matrix Implementation
desc: Replaced blank canvas in Section 04 with an interactive 6-pillar bento grid highlighting Cloud, Web, Mobile, AI, E-Commerce, and UI/UX engineering capabilities.

title: Services Section Restructuring (Manager Brief)
desc: Restructured homepage and services page into 3 core categories (Development, AI & Automation, Digital Marketing) with 11 specialized solution cards and CTAs.

title: Full Services Page 11-Solution Breakdown
desc: Created comprehensive detail panels for all 11 services on services.php, incorporating complete 'What We Build' scope items and custom action buttons.

title: Unique Subpage Hero Telemetry Modules
desc: Customized hero sections across all 6 subpages with distinct widgets including Domain Filter Ribbon, Enterprise DNA Checklist, Sprint Stepper, and Priority Cards.

title: Section 02 Orbit Enlargement & Alignment
desc: Enlarged Section 02 orbit canvas to 620x620px with 205px radius, locked vertical center alignment with narrative text, and ensured zero layout clipping.

title: Flagship Project Showcase Redesign
desc: Overhauled Section 06 into a full-width Red Apple Superstore showcase card with live impact metrics, realistic device mockup, and removed side thumbnail box.

title: Horizontal Section Overflow Resolution
desc: Applied strict CSS overflow constraints (overflow-x: clip) and container box-sizing rules across all sections to eliminate right-side screen spilling.

title: Active Button Visual Theme Standardization
desc: Updated active filter buttons across technology stack and portfolio tabs from bright purple to sleek dark navy (#07152f) matching the primary navbar CTA button.

title: Static HTML Build Pipeline & Offline Compilation
desc: Developed and executed an automated Python compilation script converting master PHP templates into 7 standalone HTML files for seamless browser file:// execution.
